data.narrative:
Cohesive Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company led by David Pietrocola that has raised $5M+. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector contains 10 peers, comprised of 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total raised of $5M as a proxy for pre-money valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-Series A progression yields a $12M implied valuation. Peer-median triangulation was not viable; while 10 same-sector comps exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier companies yielded fewer than three datapoints, making a narrow peer multiple unreliable. Relying on broader sector medians would introduce excessive noise given the heterogeneity across robotics subsectors.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $14M (high), with a midpoint of $12M. This estimate rests on a single validated method and carries material uncertainty around appropriate stage-progression multiples for frontier robotics companies. The narrow peer set and absence of direct comparable transactions limits confidence in the range. Key sensitivities include assumed deployment velocity post-Series A and whether Cohesive's technical positioning justifies multiples at the upper or lower end of seed-stage advancement norms.
